title: A Multi-Resolvent Hierarchy for the ETH Smooth Function
summary: The eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) parametrizes off-diagonal matrix elements by a smooth function whose microscopic origin remains largely phenomenological. We develop a multi-resolvent hierarchy that derives this smooth structure from the microscopic Hamiltonian. Starting from exact projection identities, we express the ETH variance as $f_{ji}^2=D_{ji}+g_{ji}$, where $D_{ji}$ is the diagonal-overlap baseline and $g_{ji}=\sum_{r\ge2}g_{ji}^{(r)}$ is a systematically improvable hierarchy of multi-channel interference processes.
